name: DimDate
desc: 90 continuous days, 1 Jan 2026 to 31 Mar 2026. Deliberately short: your first assignment is to replace it with a DAX date table.

name: DimProduct
desc: 24 products in 4 categories. Includes a discontinued flag, unit cost and list price for margin calculations.

name: DimCustomer
desc: 30 customers with segment, city, join date and loyalty tier. Some cities repeat across customers; join dates span 2022 to 2026 for cohort analysis.

name: DimRegion
desc: 4 sales regions with the manager, target multiplier and country. The RegionKey is what FactSales, FactBudget and the RLS table join on.

name: DimEmployee
desc: 18 employees in a parent-child hierarchy (ManagerKey points at another EmployeeKey). Built for PATH(), RLS by org position and hierarchy visuals.

fk.why: The CEO has no manager: the root of the parent-child hierarchy.

name: FactSales
desc: 100 order lines, Jan–Mar 2026. Multiple lines share an OrderID (for DISTINCTCOUNT), some lines are returns (negative quantity), and OrderDate ≠ ShipDate (role-playing dimension). Discount is a fraction of ListPrice.

fk.why: One order ships on 2 Apr, after the deliberately short DimDate ends. The first DAX assignment replaces DimDate.

name: FactBudget
desc: 48 rows: monthly budget by Region × Category for Jan–Mar 2026. Different grain from FactSales (month, not day; category, not product). Built for budget vs actual and TREATAS.

name: FactInventory
desc: 80 rows: weekly stock snapshot for 8 products × 10 weeks. A snapshot fact — summing QuantityOnHand across weeks is wrong. Built for semi-additive measures (LASTDATE, LASTNONBLANK).

name: RawOrdersExport (messy)
desc: 30 rows exported from a legacy system. Contains: header junk row, mixed date formats, currency symbols in numbers, trailing spaces, inconsistent casing, a fully null column, duplicate rows and "N/A" strings. Your Power Query playground.

name: SurveyWide (unpivot)
desc: 12 rows in a wide layout: one column per month. Built for Unpivot, and for the "why is this the wrong shape" conversation.

name: UserRegionMapping (RLS)
desc: 12 rows mapping a login to one or more regions. Some users have two rows (multi-region), one user has ALL. Built for dynamic RLS with USERPRINCIPALNAME().

fk.why: RegionKey 0 means all regions (the AccessLevel = All row).

name: ExchangeRates
desc: 39 rows: weekly USD rates for EUR, GBP, CAD. Rates only exist on Mondays, so lookups need "last known rate" logic. Built for currency conversion patterns.

name: CustomerTargets (many-to-many)
desc: 20 rows: quarterly revenue targets by Segment and LoyaltyTier, not by customer. Neither column is unique, so it cannot join 1:many to DimCustomer. Built for bridge tables and many-to-many.

name: WebEvents (sessions)
desc: 100 rows of click events with SessionID, UserKey and timestamp. Built for funnel analysis, EARLIER/window functions, session duration, and "first purchase" cohort logic.
